en.headline: 366 commits, 50 issues: daily-report tooling, research and OpenCode skills
en.teaser: Most of the window went into the daily GitHub activity report, the meld-deepresearch skill family and OpenCode skill tooling, alongside a steady stream of bug reports filed against OpenChamber and OpenCode.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-02 to 2026-10-31 with no missing days. Totals were 366 commits, 0 pull requests, 50 issues and 0 reviews, plus 619 automated commits recorded separately.

### Daily report and personal repo

Most of the work landed in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, where the daily GitHub activity report was built and then iterated on: a Pages-hosted daily digest with an AI summary, a workflow that accepts a manual date input, and a switch to rolling updates every two hours with a more detailed summary. Follow-up fixes covered dark-mode readability, the headline contract, a test-render assertion collector bug, and inline code and bold rendering in the AI summary.

### Research and translation skills

`meld-deepresearch` moved through several releases, adding a renderer, merge, validator, gaps and genre templates, explicit handling for access-blocked sources, validator hints, and a thin `meld.py` CLI wrapping the gates. `sopen-translate` was started from scratch as an MV3 browser extension with bilingual page rendering, chunk splitting, a circuit breaker, a provider protocol layer and glossary pipeline, then trimmed to page translation only with smoke tests and JSDoc type checking.

### OpenCode tooling

`opencode-skill-management` implemented the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, shipped release candidates through trusted publishing, and reached v1.0.0 and v1.1.0, the latter switching all actions to a single JSON object result. `opencode-agent-sandbox` collected knowledge notes on OpenCode V2 distribution, authentication and Windows path pitfalls. `opencode-go-model-picker` added agent-discovery and snapshot-summary scripts, atomic snapshot writes and version-drift checks, and released up to v2.0.0 with priced accounting and Console calibration.

### Upstream reports

Outside own repositories, 26 issues went to `openchamber/openchamber` covering storage management, MCP settings, session retention hints, quote cards, file-view commenting, context panel math and capture resolution, plus 11 discussion threads. `anomalyco/opencode` received 12 issues, mostly about MiMo vision models and the Windows desktop CLI. Smaller reports went to `oh-my-opencode-slim`, `OfficeCLI` and the SenseNova skill repositories. `asset-inventory` shipped v1.15.4 and v1.15.5 with skill invocation corrections, and `myBlog` added OpenChamber capture samples.

highlights.text: Reported an AI narration generation failure in the daily report pipeline.
v0.4.0 introduced the meld.py CLI wrapping all six gates behind one outdir.
v1.1.0 changed all four skill_management actions to return one JSON object.
2.0.0 added priced accounting via quota-math and Console calibration.
Opened a bug that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Reported that mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input but the Go endpoint rejects images with 400.
Opened an OpenCode v2 integration request to fix the skills install path and add an mcp target.

zh.headline: 366 次提交、50 个 issue：日报工具、研究技能与 OpenCode 工具链
zh.teaser: 本窗口主要投入在 GitHub 活动日报、meld-deepresearch 技能家族和 OpenCode 技能工具上，同时向 OpenChamber 与 OpenCode 提交了一批缺陷报告。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-10-02 至 2026-10-31，没有缺失数据的日期。总计 366 次提交、0 个 PR、50 个 issue、0 次评审，另有 619 次自动提交单独统计。

### 日报与个人仓库

大部分工作落在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`：搭建了托管在 Pages 上的 GitHub 活动日报，带 AI 摘要，工作流支持手动指定日期，随后改为每两小时滚动更新并让摘要更详细。后续修复涉及深色模式可读性、headline 契约、test-render 断言收集器缺陷，以及 AI 摘要中的内联代码与加粗渲染。

### 研究与翻译技能

`meld-deepresearch` 连续发布多个版本，加入渲染器、合并、校验器、缺口分析与体裁模板，明确处理无法访问的来源，补充校验提示，并用 `meld.py` 薄 CLI 封装各道关卡。`sopen-translate` 从零起步，做成 MV3 扩展，具备双语页面渲染、分块、熔断、进度、提供商协议层与术语表流水线，之后删去划词翻译只保留整页翻译，并补上冒烟测试与 JSDoc 类型检查。

### OpenCode 工具

`opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，通过 trusted publishing 发布候选版本，并推进到 v1.0.0 与 v1.1.0，后者把所有动作改为返回单个 JSON 对象。`opencode-agent-sandbox` 整理了 OpenCode V2 分发、认证与 Windows 路径坑的知识库。`opencode-go-model-picker` 新增 agent 发现与快照摘要脚本、原子写入与版本漂移检查，并发布到 2.0.0，加入计价核算与 Console 校准。

### 上游反馈

自有仓库之外，向 `openchamber/openchamber` 提交了 26 个 issue，涉及存储管理、MCP 设置、会话保留提示、引用卡片、文件视图评论、上下文面板计算与截图分辨率，并发起 11 个讨论。`anomalyco/opencode` 收到 12 个 issue，多与 MiMo 视觉模型和 Windows 桌面版 CLI 有关。另有少量报告提交给 `oh-my-opencode-slim`、`OfficeCLI` 和 SenseNova 技能仓库。`asset-inventory` 发布 v1.15.4 与 v1.15.5 并修正技能调用说明，`myBlog` 补充了 OpenChamber 截图样例。

highlights.text: 报告日报流水线中 AI 叙述生成失败的问题。
v0.4.0 引入 meld.py CLI，用一个 outdir 参数封装全部六道关卡。
v1.1.0 将 skill_management 的四个动作改为返回单个 JSON 对象。
2.0.0 通过 quota-math 加入计价核算与 Console 校准。
提交缺陷：设置中的 MCP 页面遗漏了 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
报告 mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 声称支持图像输入，但 Go 端点对图片一律返回 400。
提交 OpenCode v2 集成请求，修正技能安装路径并新增 mcp 目标。
